I am currently an ACCS Anaesthetics trainee in the UK with intentions to dual train in anaesthesia and intensive care medicine. I am passionate about clinical research, having completed the Academic Foundation Programme (AFP), and I continue to pursue research alongside my clinical training. My research interests focus on translational work aimed at improving outcomes in anaesthesia, perioperative medicine and intensive care. 

Outside of medicine I enjoy staying active and spending time outdoors. I play water polo and am currently in preparation for an IronMan 70.3.
